stem: Chuck wants to improve the introduction to his story by adding another sentence to the second paragraph (sentences 2–4). Which sentence could BEST be added after sentence 3?

options.label: A
options.text: It was super early, but this was the time we had to be at the bus stop to get to school on time.

options.label: B
options.text: Baxter almost always wore a gray hoodie and jeans, no matter what season of the year it happened to be.

options.label: C
options.text: My dad is a morning person too, and he always wakes me up with a loud and annoying song.

options.label: D
options.text: He didn’t care that the sun had just come up and that the birds were still singing their daybreak tunes.
